profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a software development professional with over 25 years of experience in all aspects of the software development lifecycle. I have excellent analytical and communication skills and pay close attention to detail. Projects that I have led have been consistently completed on time and were of high quality.  I work best in a team environment and can give and receive direction well.  I learn new methodologies and technologies quickly and enjoy the challenge of the ever-changing face of software development.

Specialties: Java/J2EE application development, Web services development, Weblogic server application development/administration, Oracle and SQL Server database expertise, LDAP and related technologies, Javascript/HTML/XML development, C++ client/server development, Development on both Windows and Unix platforms.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Developer
positions.description:
	Key developer on Deltek’s Time and Expense with Employee Self Service product for the Web. Technologies/Languages include Java/J2EE, HTML/XML, Javascript, Weblogic 11g, Oracle/SQL Server, and Web Services development. The most recent project included the development of a BlackBerry interface to the time sheet module. Responsible for mentoring less experienced developers on the team in addition to the lead development activities. 
	Manager of a team of developers on Deltek’s Time Collection product, reporting directly to the Vice President of Development for the Enterprise Systems Division. Human resource responsibilities include annual performance reviews, establishment of individual professional and team goals, and participation in the hiring of new team members. Project responsibilities include development and maintenance of release project plans (working in conjunction with the other product teams), project tracking and reporting, resource management, and technical lead.  Developers maintain a multi-tier application with web client (JAVA Swing and AWT; DHTML), Windows client, IVR client, C++ web and application server, and database components. 
	Senior software engineer on Deltek’s Time Collection product.  Responsibilities include requirements analysis, systems analysis and design using object oriented methodologies, coding, and problem resolution. Accountable for all aspects of the software development lifecycle. Languages/technologies/platforms include Visual C++, Visual Basic, Java/HTML/DHTML, COM, ActiveX, RPC, ODBC, and Windows 98/NT/2000.  Databases include Oracle, SQL Server, and SQLBase. 
	Recipient of Star Performer Award 2009.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
	Project leader and programmer/analyst on the Magna/X COBOL application generator for UNIX.  Responsibilities included: coordination and coding of Common Code Library, design and implementation of underlying database dictionary, design and coding of validation routines for dictionary objects, design and coding of portions of the user interface, and site coordinator for code inspections.  Languages/platforms included ANSI C, Borland C++, Windows 3.1, and various UNIX platforms.  Databases included INGRES and Oracle. 
	Led the effort to produce and implement C coding and configuration standards.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
	Project leader and programmer/analyst on the network engineering control system.  Participated in analysis, design, coding, and systems test of various enhancements to the system.  Member of team responsible for problem resolution and maintenance of certain portions of the system.  Languages/platforms included VS-COBOL II, IBM OS Assembler, and IBM 370. 
	Recipient of ACE award Second Quarter 1989.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: 	Member of a number programming teams responsible for base and custom software. Languages/platforms included COBOL, Basic, IBM 370, Prime, VAX, and HP-3000.

positions.title: Student Trainee in Mathematics
positions.description:
	Main programmer on the Independent Parallel Runway Separation project.  Wrote complex data reduction programs in Fortran to analyze raw data collected from air traffic control simulators. 
	Recipient of special recognition for achievements as a co-op student.
